report_comment.text: NPM1 encodes nucleophosmin, a nucleolar protein involved in ribosome assembly and protein trafficking. RARA encodes retinoic acid receptor alpha, a ligand-regulated nuclear-receptor transcription factor. NPM1::RARA was confirmed by RT-qPCR in an infant with AML, a t(5;17) rearrangement and a mandibular myeloid sarcoma in a Hungarian clinical cohort. The reported infant with NPM1::RARA-positive AML achieved remission with an AML chemotherapy regimen plus ATRA and remained in first remission at the reported 36-month follow-up. Subsequent treatment included arsenic; this combination outcome does not establish isolated ATRA sensitivity.
